title: Scroll Progress Timeline
concept: Nightjar Films' production diary for The Salt Year, a fictional 16mm indie feature: six stages from script to a 38-cinema release on one red left rail that fills from the first dot to the last as you scroll, with a sticky readout (current stage, film timecode, sprocket reel bar) and chapter anchors marked aria-current.
notes: Vanilla script, no libraries: dot centres measured once per layout change (resize, ResizeObserver, fonts, load), scroll only reads scrollY and writes transforms in one rAF. Steps are a semantic ordered list; inactive steps stay readable. Collapses to a narrow left rail with a sticky top progress bar below 1024px. Reduced motion shows the full line and discrete step states. All media panels are CSS compositions; cinemas and festival are invented.
